hero.headline: I turn curiosity into code.
hero.body: I’m Dustin, a software engineer who’s been building since 2004. With over a decade of Ruby on Rails experience, my work now spans full-stack development, native iOS applications, and experimental software systems. I enjoy taking ideas apart, understanding what makes them work, and putting them back together as something useful.

about.headline: Engineer by experience. Builder by nature.
about.subtitle: Coding has been my creative outlet since 2004.
bio: I’ve been writing software for over two decades, with more than ten years spent building applications with Ruby on Rails. What started as curiosity grew into a career in full-stack development and a lasting fascination with how software works.

These days, my work extends beyond the web into native iOS development, game systems, and experimental software architecture. I enjoy taking an idea from its earliest concept through the underlying design, implementation, and all the small details that make the finished product feel right.

I’m a systems thinker at heart. I like exploring problems from different angles, challenging assumptions, and understanding not just how something works, but why it works that way. I believe good software should be thoughtfully designed, thoroughly tested, and flexible enough to evolve.
For me, programming is both an engineering discipline and a creative outlet. It’s how I explore ideas, solve problems, and bring things into existence that weren’t there before.
about.closing: When I’m away from the keyboard, I’m usually cooking, enjoying live music, riding my motorcycle, traveling, or exploring the outdoors.
